title: Marketing Data Analyst
description:
Marketing Data Analyst

Salary: Up to £60,000 + benefits
Location: London
Working pattern: Hybrid - 3 days in the office, 2 days working from home

The Opportunity

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Marketing Analytics Analyst to join a leading customer experience and marketing consultancy, working with a major global fashion brand.

You will be embedded within the client's marketing analytics function, helping to drive data-led decision-making through robust statistical analysis, campaign experimentation and customer insights.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an analytically strong individual who enjoys solving complex business problems and translating data into meaningful commercial recommendations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, execute and evaluate marketing and campaign experiments.

  • Apply statistical techniques to measure campaign effectiveness and business impact.

  • Analyse customer behaviour, marketing performance and campaign outcomes.

  • Develop and communicate actionable insights to senior stakeholders.

  • Use Python and/or SQL to manipulate, analyse and interpret data.

  • Explore experimentation techniques beyond traditional A/B testing.

  • Work closely with marketing, data and commercial teams to support strategic decisions.

  • Present findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong technical analytical skills, particularly Python and/or SQL.

  • Demonstrable experience designing, running and reporting on experiments.

  • Strong understanding of statistics and experimental design.

  • Ideally, experience applying techniques beyond standard A/B testing.

  • Retail or fashion industry experience would be highly advantageous.

  • Previous experience in marketing or customer analytics is desirable.

  • A degree in a quantitative or STEM-related discipline is beneficial.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to turn complex analysis into clear business recommendations.

The Environment

You'll join a collaborative, specialist analytics team with exposure to high-profile marketing activity and commercially significant projects. The role offers the opportunity to take real ownership of analytical work and influence decision-making for a major international brand.

Interested? Apply now to find out more.
